register.labelZh: LEAN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: lean against 和 lean on 可以說明某人如何靠着牆壁、桌子、另一個人或其他物件取得支撐。；你可以使用 LEAN 描述梯子、單車、木板或其他物件斜靠在某處。；lean on somebody 可以表示依靠某人,也可以表示向某人施壓。完整情境會顯示句子使用哪一個意思。；當你尚未作出最後決定,但目前較喜歡其中一個選擇時,可以使用 lean towards。；lean on 和 lean upon 可以描述依靠朋友、親人、同事或其他支援。
register.summaryEn: Lean against and lean on help you explain how someone uses a wall, table, person or other object for physical support. You can use LEAN to describe a ladder, bicycle, board or other object resting at an angle against something. Lean on somebody can mean depending on a person for help or putting pressure on that person. The complete situation shows which meaning is intended. Lean towards is useful when you have not made a final decision but currently prefer one option. Lean on and lean upon help you describe depending on friends, relatives, colleagues or other sources of support.
contextsEn: Explain where an object has been placed

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；他把身體靠在桌上。They leaned on him to sign.他們向他施壓,要他簽署文件。She leaned on her family for help.她依靠家人幫忙。lean on 可以表示身體靠着某物、向某人施壓,或依靠某人。請仔細閱讀完整情境。；句子可以在核心表達後加入其他資料。例如,to sign 說明對方被要求做甚麼;for advice 則說明需要哪一種支援。核心表達仍然是 lean on somebody。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Lean on can express three different ideas. Read the complete situation carefully: He leaned on the table. Additional words may explain the situation, but they are not always part of the core expression: They leaned on him to sign. The core expression is lean on him. To sign tells us what they wanted him to do. She leaned on her sister for advice. The core expression is lean on her sister. For advice tells us what kind of support she needed.
